name: POST /api/empi/candidate-links/:link_id/adjudicate - steward decision
description: Records a steward's approve/reject decision on a candidate link's open approval step and labels the match outcome for calibration. step_id is required and decision must be exactly 'approve' or 'reject' (any other value, including a missing one, is a 400); reason is optional. The deciding persona comes from the JWT, not the body. Edge cases: an unknown link_id throws 'empi: candidate link <id> not found' and surfaces as 500 InternalError rather than 404; a step_id that is already decided, or that does not belong to the link, likewise fails inside the service as a 500; approving feeds a positive calibration label and reject a negative one, so double-adjudicating the same step is not a safe retry.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
body.step_id is missing or body.decision is anything other than "approve" or "reject"
the link_id in the path matches no candidate-link row — surfaced as a 500, not a 404
the approval step is already decided, does not belong to the link, or the decision write fails

testCases.name: Steward approves a candidate link (triggers reversible merge)

payload.reason: Records confirmed as the same patient
